acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of functional layout improvements varies significantly based on the scope, complexity, and materials chosen. Factors like structural changes, plumbing or electrical work, and the size of the area being reconfigured all impact the budget. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation and assessment of your specific project in Berkeley and the surrounding East Bay area.
